selection: After E77/E78 inspection, compare the first four visible noteheads above Hec / est / do- / mus; retrospective, reference-exposed and unblinded.
coordinate_convention: Original image pixels; y increases downward. Points are approximate manually selected notehead centres, not automatic transcription.

items.centres_limit: Square-note centres and red-to-adjacent-rule spacing are approximate; rule/underlay interpretation requires review.
Hufnagel noteheads have stems and non-square shapes; centres, local rule spacing and syllable alignment require review.

tolerance_scope: Illustrative post-inspection sensitivity, not measured uncertainty or a statistical confidence interval. The arithmetic does not validate the selected centres or notation reading.
